page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred throughout. Top: title in large capitals and italic lines, then a short sentence in roman, a quotation in italic, a printer's ornament, then the imprint and date at the foot. Handwritten marks at the margin and foot are not printed.

main_text.l: DATVM AB IIS, QVI AB EC-
ne errorum Papatus, & admonitione graui ad
Si postquam inquinamenta mundi, per agni-
tionem Domini & Seruatoris Iesu Christi effu-
gerint, his rursus implicati superentur, facta est
vltima eorum conditio deterior priori. Satius
enim fuisset eis non cognouisse viam iustitiæ,
quàm cognita illa, regredi à sancta

page.notes: The ornament between the quotation and the imprint is a printer's device, not text. The handwritten "4" at the top right and the handwritten marks and library shelf mark "A: 438926O" at the foot are not printed and are left out. Doubtful: "ANTIDOTVS" first line may be set with an enlarged initial A; read as printed. The line "Petrus Apostolus in 2. c. 2." is a citation line, kept as a line.
